headline: The cart's other half: FloorBoss carts now swing their counterweight
lede: Loaded carts used to pivot through racks that their tail would have clipped. The tail law makes the back diagonal real — routing, landings and tell pixels all know about it now, with a harness that measures the lie it killed: 2,009 ghost-clips on the same boards the new physics drives clean.

notes.text: #2760 shipped (2b3eb7e): pivots refuse turns whose counterweight diagonal B − dIn − dOut holds a rack; a rack landing across a committed backswing re-routes the plan that tick. 1,982 of 19,766 autopilot plans legitimately re-route under the law.

Measured refusal: the click-refusal half was dead code — whole-body net ≡ knee net, netdiff 0 across 6,543 boards. It stayed out of the sim (#2692 doctrine), pinned by a source gate that reddens if why:'tail' ever comes back.
Five honest re-pins after physics (parity traces, sealed rig, shift + attract seeds, stair reference), each re-measured by sweep, never widened. Five-seed economy holds: 5/5 wins, 0 jams.

Ops: main was found checked out in another lane's worktree — gh's post-merge bookkeeping died though the merge completed; plus this box's clock ran ~7 h behind GitHub, which silently under-counts claim liveness. Both filed toward #2758.
